name: skill_rotation_complete_sequence
description: Complete sequence: 3 questions per skill, rotating after each set of 3 correct answers

scenario.assertion: After 3 correct on quad.identify, streak should be 3

questions.note: Rotated to next skill, streak resets to 1

scenario.assertion: After 3 correct on quad.vertex.form, should rotate away

questions.note: Continues on quad.vertex.form - quad.factor.a1 requires p_mastery >= 0.9 for prerequisites

scenario.assertion: Rotation requires both correct_streak >= 3 AND prerequisite mastery >= 0.9

critical_assertions: Questions 1-3: All quad.identify (3 consecutive correct = rotation trigger)
Questions 7-9: quad.vertex.form continues (no rotation until p_mastery >= 0.9)
Rotation requires BOTH: correct_streak >= 3 AND prerequisite mastery >= 0.9
